theorems.name: Submission.dtc_cone_wedge_vanishes
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection x = x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), R.orient x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft β x) = 0
